newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia's ARS in De Beers talks in Moscow.
newsitem.headline: Russia's ARS in De Beers talks in Moscow.

text.p: Russia's Almazy Rossii-Sakha (ARS) monopoly diamond producer is in talks in Moscow with officials from De Beers on a new trade deal, an ARS source said on Thursday.
"Yes, there are De Beers officials here and they are talking to us," a spokesman for ARS vice-president Sergei Ulin said.
Interfax news agency said discussions on a plan for a new trade deal had begun at the working group level.
The two sides discussed the world diamond market on Wednesday, it said, describing the discussions as "working talks."
Gary Ralfe, director of De Beers' London-based Central Selling Organisation (CSO), was present at the talks, according to Interfax.

ARS is the partner to De Beers in a stalled gem deal. De Beers stopped all purchases of diamonds from Russia at the end of last year when it cancelled its interim arrangement after Russia failed to approve or reject a new trade deal.
